description: Add advanced WiFi attack modules: AP Auto-Clone, KRACK attack, DoS (CTS/RTS/Beacon/QoS), and Client Isolation/Fragmentation
steps: 1. Create posframework/ap_clone.py - APCloneEngine class that: (a) monitors for target AP's SSID after deauth, (b) automatically clones SSID/channel/security settings, (c) handles WPA3 transition mode (downgrade to WPA2), (d) auto-channel hops when legitimate AP returns. Class pattern: __init__(interface, db, target_bssid), start(), stop(), _clone_loop(), _detect_ap_return(), _switch_channel(). Linux only.

2. Create posframework/krack.py - KRACKEngine class for Key Reinstallation attacks: (a) CVE-2017-13077/13078 exploitation, (b) Force key reinstallation by replaying message 3, (c) Reset nonce/replay counters, (d) Implement packet replay after successful KRACK. Class: __init__(interface, target_client, target_bssid), start(), stop(), _monitor_handshake(), _replay_msg3(), _inject_replayed_packets(). Linux only, requires monitor mode.

3. Create posframework/dos_wifi.py - WiFiDoSEngine class with multiple attack modes: (a) CTS/RTS frame flooding (reserve channel), (b) Beacon rate exhaustion (flood beacons to exhaust AP processing), (c) QoS null frame DoS (force station disconnect), (d) Fragmentation attack (802.11 fragment overflow). Class: __init__(interface), start(mode='cts_flood'), stop(), _cts_flood(), _beacon_exhaust(), _qos_null_dos(), _fragment_overflow(). Has DoSMode enum.

4. Create posframework/client_isolation.py - ClientIsolationEngine class: (a) Disassociate clients (different from deauth - uses reason code 8), (b) Cause AP-to-client communication breakdown, (c) Force clients into handoff mode, (d) More subtle than deauth floods (lower frame rate, varied reason codes). Class: __init__(interface, db), start(), stop(), _disassoc_loop(), _force_handoff(), add_target(client_mac, bssid).
acceptance_criteria: All 4 new files pass AST syntax validation
Each class follows existing pattern: __init__, start(), stop(), daemon thread, logging via config.log
ap_clone.py has APCloneEngine with WPA3 transition mode detection
krack.py has KRACKEngine with message 3 replay logic
dos_wifi.py has WiFiDoSEngine with 4 attack modes
client_isolation.py has ClientIsolationEngine with disassociation and handoff
verification: Run: python3 -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f'posframework/{m}.py').read()) for m in ['ap_clone','krack','dos_wifi','client_isolation']]"
Run: grep -c 'class.*Engine' posframework/ap_clone.py posframework/krack.py posframework/dos_wifi.py posframework/client_isolation.py
